landing.faq_a1: No. The script is under 1 KB and reports asynchronously via sendBeacon — it never blocks rendering, and the overhead is negligible.
landing.faq_a2: All data is stored in the database of the server you deploy on — it never touches a third party and can be exported anytime.
landing.faq_a3: Fully supported: set the ICP number and custom footer code in Admin → Branding; they render automatically in the footer.
landing.faq_a4: Yes. Logo, favicon, primary color and site name are all configurable in the admin panel — perfect white-labeling without touching code.
landing.faq_a5: A complete REST API, a pixel SDK and detailed development docs are provided, all under the MIT license — modify freely.
landing.faq_q1: Will the tracker slow down my website?
landing.faq_q3: Can I show an ICP filing number in the footer?

landing.feature_api_desc: A complete REST API plus the pixel SDK — pipe your data into your own BI and reporting stack.
landing.feature_goals_desc: Signups, purchases, form submits — define custom goals and funnels to quantify every key action.
landing.feature_heatmap_desc: Visualize click density across the page and redesign landing pages with evidence, not guesses.
landing.feature_privacy_desc: No cookies, no data selling, optional IP anonymization — GDPR-compliant with a built-in consent banner.
landing.feature_realtime_desc: Pageviews, visitors, session duration and bounce rate refresh in seconds — always keep a finger on the pulse.
landing.feature_replay_desc: Replay every visitor journey frame by frame — mouse movements, scrolls and clicks — and spot friction instantly.
landing.features_subtitle: From real-time visitors to session replay, from conversion goals to team collaboration.
landing.features_title: A complete analytics toolbox for growth teams
landing.hero_subtitle: The open-source, self-hosted web analytics platform: cookieless, blazing fast, and your data stays yours. As powerful as the big names — as private as your own notebook.
